The World of Tom Clancy's The Division

Dark Horse and Ubisoft's official Division reference book, framing SHD history, training, structure, tools and mission across the first two games.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Official reference work

This is a reference and art book, not a standalone campaign or a source for reconstructed game scenes. Dark Horse and Ubisoft present it as a developer-collaboration guide to the Division universe. [1]

What it anchors in the archive

The book gives high-level context for the SHD's mission, organization and preparedness. Its official Ubisoft summary is used here only as an evidence locator for independently written records about the crisis framework; the archive does not reproduce its prose, artwork, layouts or timeline pages. [2][3]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    The World of Tom Clancy's The Division is an official Dark Horse and Ubisoft reference book produced in collaboration with the game's developers. [1]

  2. confirmed

    Ubisoft describes the book as a lore guide to the Strategic Homeland Division's classified history, training and structure, alongside its tactics, equipment and mission. [2]

  3. confirmed

    Ubisoft's preview places the lore book in the Division universe and identifies a timeline spanning the period between the first and second games. [3]
